mode.title: Mode
mode.description: list searches only and is cheapest; place scrapes one known place ID; search lists places, fetches details, and optionally reviews.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: Choose which records are saved to the Dataset. list mode always returns listing records.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Business/category query, for example 'dentists' or 'coffee shops'. Required for list and search mode.

searchLocation.title: 📍 Where should we search?
searchLocation.description: Free-form location such as Berlin, Germany. Used together with the search query.

geolocationParameters.title: 🧭 Geolocation parameters
geolocationParameters.description: Optional structured location fields. These are used when the free-form location is empty.

country.title: 🌎 Country
country.description: Country or region, for example Germany.

stateRegion.title: 🧭 State or region
stateRegion.description: State, region, province, or administrative area.

county.title: 📌 County
county.description: County, district, borough, or local administrative area.

city.title: 🏙️ City
city.description: City or locality, for example Berlin.

customGeolocation.title: 📐 Custom geolocation
customGeolocation.description: Optional geometry and coordinate fields for anchoring the Google Maps search area.

geometryType.title: 🔷 Geometry type
geometryType.description: Optional geometry hint for custom coordinates.

coordinates.title: 📍 Coordinates
coordinates.description: Optional coordinates as text, for example '52.520008, 13.404954'.

radiusKm.title: 📏 Radius in km
radiusKm.description: Optional search radius. When provided, it is converted to an approximate map zoom.

coordinatesJson.title: 🧾 Coordinates JSON
coordinatesJson.description: Optional GeoJSON Point, Feature, or coordinate array. Example: {"type":"Point","coordinates":[13.404954,52.520008]}

placeId.title: Place ID
placeId.description: Known Google Maps place ID. Required for place mode.

maxPlaces.title: Max places
maxPlaces.description: Maximum number of search results to list or fully scrape.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per place
maxReviews.description: Maximum reviews to fetch for each place. Set to 0 to skip reviews.

maxTotalReviews.title: Max total reviews
maxTotalReviews.description: Global review cap across the whole run. Set to 0 for no global cap.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of places to scrape in parallel in search mode. Higher values are faster but can increase blocking risk.

zoom.title: Map zoom
zoom.description: Google Maps zoom level. Higher values narrow the search area.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Minimum delay between HTTP requests. Actual delay is randomized up to 2x this value.

proxyConfiguration.title: Apify Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy or custom proxies.

proxyUrl.title: Manual proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Optional direct proxy URL used when Apify Proxy is disabled.

enrichWebsites.title: Enrich websites
enrichWebsites.description: Fetch listed websites to extract title, description, emails, and social links.

websiteEnrichmentDepth.title: Website enrichment depth
websiteEnrichmentDepth.description: Homepage only is fastest. Contact pages also checks contact/about/impressum pages for emails and social links.

websiteTimeoutSeconds.title: Website timeout
websiteTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each website enrichment request. Keep this lower than the Google Maps timeout to avoid slow websites increasing run cost.

skipSocialWebsites.title: Skip social profile websites
skipSocialWebsites.description: Skip website enrichment when Google Maps lists a social profile such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, or Twitter. This is faster and avoids many 429 responses.

leadFilters.title: Lead filters
leadFilters.description: Optional filters applied after full place details are fetched. Filtered places are skipped from Dataset output and reviews.

minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count
minReviewCount.description: Skip places below this review count.

mustHaveWebsite.title: Must have website
mustHaveWebsite.description: Only keep places with a website.

mustHavePhone.title: Must have phone
mustHavePhone.description: Only keep places with a phone number.

categoryIncludes.title: Category includes
categoryIncludes.description: Only keep places whose categories include this text, for example cafe.

enableSqliteCheckpoint.title: Enable SQLite checkpoint
enableSqliteCheckpoint.description: Keep an internal SQLite copy for deduplication/checkpointing. Dataset remains the primary output.

sqlitePath.title: SQLite path
sqlitePath.description: Internal SQLite path when checkpointing is enabled.

enableBillingEvents.title: Enable billing events (legacy)
enableBillingEvents.description: Legacy testing flag. Production monetization is enabled automatically when pay-per-event pricing is configured in Apify Console. For local tests, use ACTOR_TEST_PAY_PER_EVENT=true.
